name: APSS (Approximate Projected Point Set Surfaces)
aliases: MLS projection via Approximate Projected Point Set Surfaces
definition: An iterative method to project a query point onto a surface defined by a point set with normals, using Moving Least Squares (MLS). summary: APSS is an iterative method projecting points onto surfaces defined by point sets with normals, distinguished by tracking cross-product and dot-product terms for refined surface fitting.
